title: Claimwake
summary: Start: enter Claimwake. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the interceptor sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. Dead homesteads. Reclaim is the pocket on the claim slate. Strip is the other choice. The law is red. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Dead Hollow's shell. Red Keel heat rises. The pocket still takes a core. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
